{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Fine-gauge crew-neck sweater, slim fit, hip length, deep burgundy #6D1F2F, merino wool
A-line midi skirt, mid-calf length, softly pleated at the waist, charcoal #36393F, wool crepe
Single-breasted coat, straight cut, knee length, camel #B08D63, wool and cashmere blend
Opaque tights, sheer-matte finish, black #1A1A1A, nylon with elastane
Ankle boots, almond toe, low block heel, black #1C1C1C, smooth leather
Small structured top-handle bag, black #1C1C1C, grained leather
Stud earrings, small round pearls, ivory #F2EBDD, with a gold-tone setting

This outfit reads as classic and restrained, which suits an evening at the theatre. The deep burgundy knit adds warmth and a little evening richness, while the charcoal skirt keeps the look quiet and polished. The camel coat is the right weight for an autumn evening and sits easily over the neat, tonal base. Low block-heeled boots stay comfortable through a long performance and the interval, and the pearl studs and small bag finish the look without fuss."}
